mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the arm to the circulation was most worthwhile: the tissue inset linked oxygen and nutrient delivery, carbon dioxide removal, and the fluid that needs returning.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to connect the ducts was confusing because the need to attach the collectors to the arm first was not apparent from their descriptions.

surprise.text: I was surprised that muscle movement helps squeeze lymph onward and that lymph vessels can also contract.

arbitrary.text: The required assembly order felt somewhat arbitrary: the ducts could not connect to the pathways until the pathways had been added to the arm.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the constructions made the relationships between circulation, muscle cells and lymphatic return interesting to follow, despite the unclear dependency.
